newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Telekom option trade starts Nov 20.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom option trade starts Nov 20.

text.p: Trade in options for shares in Deutsche Telekom AG is scheduled to start on November 20, two days after trade in the main shares of the telecom firm goes ahead, the Deutsche Boerse stock exchange said on Tuesday.
Trading will take place on the Deutsche Terminboerse (DTB), the exchange said in a statement.
The Deutsche Boerse said it would be issuing an option of Deutsche Telekom shares with a contract size set at 500 shares and expiry periods of one, two, three, six and nine months.
The Telekom issue is Europe's largest ever, with some 500 million shares being issued at a price of between 25 and 30 marks per share.
Final allocation details and the public announcement of the offer price per share of Deutsche Telekom are expected by November 18.
The first quotation for the shares is due to be made at 11.30 local time on November 18, around an hour after the start of bourse trade.

Bourse trade in the stock will go ahead in bundles of a minimum 100 shares. On IBIS electronic trade, minimum trades will initially be set at 5,000 shares for the first week after issue, falling to 500 shares thereafter.
The stock is due to be included in the DAX index of leading German shares from November 19.
